import json, glob, collections, pathlib
c=collections.Counter\(\)
for p in glob.glob\(r'data/lerobot/session*/**/meta/info.json', recursive=True\):
    d=json.load\(open\(p,encoding='utf-8'\)\)
    n=sum\('headband_imu' in k for k in d['features']\)
    parts=pathlib.PurePath\(p\).parts
    date=next\(\(x for x in parts if x[:4].isdigit\(\) and x[4]=='-'\), '?'\)
    c[\(date,n\)]+=1
for \(date,n\),cnt in sorted\(c.items\(\)\):
    print\(date, f'{n} imu\(s\):', cnt\)
EOF)
